baseline: A0 fixed reference Q, no contrastive loss
single_change: C0 adds response-flip InfoNCE; Q remains fixed
artifact_policy: Per condition: manifest, summary, verification, per-seed metrics and checkpoint; candidate summary includes paired A0 rows copied from baseline_A0.

source.terms: Noncommercial use; cite Chang, Hsu & Chen, EDM 2015, as stated in local README.txt.

preparation.selection: Top students and exercises by eligible attempt frequency; no score-based ranking.
preparation.filters: Known exercise with nonempty topic, boolean correct, nonmissing timestamp.
preparation.pair_dedup: Earliest time_done per student-exercise; first source row breaks ties.
preparation.q_reference: One-hot exercise topic from exercise metadata; topic is a proxy concept, not expert mastery ground truth.
preparation.q_true_file: Exact copy of Q_matrix.npy for existing runner compatibility; reference Q only.
preparation.id_mapping: Ascending retained source user_id and exercise name mapped to zero-based IDs.
preparation.split: Per-student seeded random 70/10/20 interaction split after pair dedup.
